payload.body_you:
Friendship gets practical. Who checks in when they do not need anything? Who assumes you will host, organize, introduce, donate, solve, or hold the group together? Saturn moving through your 11th house shows the difference between community and people who have become accustomed to your labor.

Put more time into the friendships where care moves in both directions. Accept the role when it matters to you and you have the capacity. Decline it when everyone else's plan depends on you being exhausted. Review the goals you keep calling your future. Give the real ones dates, money, and next steps. Let the old ones stop taking up space simply because you once announced them.
